three_gaps.gap3_organic: possibly 0 years — organic writing undetectable after 1600 yr

verdict: Java's writing adoption lag (660 yr from Brahmi) is at the 57th percentile of all known diffusion events — slow but not anomalous. The 3,500-year comparison with Sumeria is misleading: it conflates invention with adoption. The probability of finding pre-400 CE organic writing in tropical Java is ~10^-13. The 400 CE date marks the start of STONE writing technology, not civilization. Non-written information systems (wayang, gamelan, pranata mangsa, batik, toponymy) demonstrate civilizational complexity WITHOUT writing.
